metadata.description: Marketplace for the AI SDLC plugin. Add it from GitHub (`/plugin marketplace add LordPotter7/AISdlc`) or by filesystem path during development; `./` resolves against the marketplace root either way. The name is a registry key fixed at first registration, not a claim about where the plugin can be used.

plugins.name: aisdlc
plugins.description: Adaptive evidence-driven AI SDLC lifecycle, gates, evidence, and learning loop. Install once, then run `/aisdlc:init` in any repository you want lifecycle-managed.
